Updates `@cloudflare/vitest-plugin` from 1.4.2 to 1.4.6
Release notes

Sourced from @​cloudflare/vitest-plugin's releases.

@​cloudflare/vitest-plugin@​1.4.6

Patch Changes

  • #15708 3464abc Thanks @​samstarling! - Dispose Workflow step results and introspection modifiers after use

    Release RPC resources deterministically during local Workflow execution and introspection. This prevents undisposed RPC warnings and requests being cancelled after their execution context has ended. Live step results retain their original data shape, including typed-array offsets and backing buffers. Callbacks that finish after a step times out also release their results, cancelling unused streams without delaying retries.

    Disposing an introspector still aborts the instance if modifier acquisition failed, without introducing a teardown error. Non-stream results containing function-valued array properties are rejected according to the serialisable-output contract, instead of silently discarding those properties during storage normalisation.

  • #15846 a88cac4 Thanks @​oddharsh! - Fail with an error instead of hanging when local dev requests can't work under Bun

    Bun's fetch() ignores the undici dispatcheroven-sh/bun#39247createTestHarness()'s server.fetch() and server.getWorker()'s fetch(), email() and scheduled() now throw a UserError, requests to the dev server URL get a 503 naming the cause, and starting remote bindings throws a UserError. Each of these used to hang with no error. server.getWorker().getEnv() and getExport() keep working under Bun.

  • Updated dependencies [4508172, 61fc739, 3464abc, a88cac4, 262021d]:

    • wrangler@4.151.3
    • miniflare@5.20261019.1-beta

@​cloudflare/vitest-plugin@​1.4.5

Patch Changes

  • #16135 329d757 Thanks @​Zyles! - Fix test runs slowing down file after file, and stalling, with isolate: false

    With isolate: false, Vitest hands a worker's module runner to the pool again for every test file the worker runs, and the pool wrapped the runner's module fetches in one more layer each time, so imports got slower with every file until runs stalled. The pool now patches each module runner once.

  • Updated dependencies [37ab91c, 0ae7926]:

    • miniflare@5.20261019.0-beta
    • wrangler@4.151.2

@​cloudflare/vitest-plugin@​1.4.4

Patch Changes

  • Updated dependencies [e1d1b77, e13d5cc, 42c6912, 4a5377f]:
    • miniflare@5.20261012.1-beta
    • wrangler@4.151.1

@​cloudflare/vitest-plugin@​1.4.3

Patch Changes

  • #16248 ad01099 Thanks @​mattjohnsonpint! - Fix V8 coverage failing with Vitest 5.0.4

    Tests using V8 coverage with Vitest 5.0.4 no longer fail with an assertion error during teardown.

  • #16163 5f12934 Thanks @​edmundhung! - Fix Workers tests failing with Vitest's filesystem module cache

    This supports Vitest 4.1's test.experimental.fsModuleCache and Vitest 5's test.fsModuleCache.

Updates `wrangler` from 4.151.0 to 4.151.3
Release notes

Sourced from wrangler's releases.

wrangler@4.151.3

Patch Changes

  • #15611 4508172 Thanks @​taylorlee! - Allow wrangler dev to start module Workers without a default export

    Previously, wrangler dev failed to start module Workers that exported only named entrypoints, such as RPC services, unless an unused default export was added. These Workers now start normally in local development without that workaround.

  • #16370 61fc739 Thanks @​WalshyDev! - Fetch the remote config diff from the configured compliance region

    When a Worker was last deployed from the dashboard, wrangler deploy and wrangler versions upload download its remote configuration to compare with the local one. These requests ignored the compliance_region field in the Wrangler configuration file and only honoured the CLOUDFLARE_COMPLIANCE_REGION environment variable. A FedRAMP High Worker configured through the config file would send them to api.cloudflare.com instead of api.fed.cloudflare.com, and the deploy would fail with authentication errors. They now use the same compliance region as the rest of the deploy.

  • #15846 a88cac4 Thanks @​oddharsh! - Fail with an error instead of hanging when local dev requests can't work under Bun

    Bun's fetch() ignores the undici dispatcheroven-sh/bun#39247createTestHarness()'s server.fetch() and server.getWorker()'s fetch(), email() and scheduled() now throw a UserError, requests to the dev server URL get a 503 naming the cause, and starting remote bindings throws a UserError. Each of these used to hang with no error. server.getWorker().getEnv() and getExport() keep working under Bun.

  • #16359 262021d Thanks @​tw4! - Stop --strict deploys and version uploads from aborting when the API omits optional binding fields

    Previously, wrangler deploy --strict and wrangler versions upload --strict could report a destructive change for an unchanged configuration, for example an R2 bucket in the default jurisdiction, because a field the API left out was compared as removed. Missing and unset optional fields are now treated as equal, so these commands proceed when the local configuration matches the deployed Worker.

  • Updated dependencies [3464abc]:

    • miniflare@5.20261019.1-beta
